intermediate.name: Col du Tourmalet
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (HC) Col du Tourmalet (89.6 km)

story: A 20-rider breakaway formed after a very fast start. The 4 minute maximum advantage was made undone by team UAE. With 5k to the top, Pogacar made the jump to Adam Yates before moving on solo to the stage win and a 39 second time gain on Vingegaard.
